notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 23 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting': Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough, Tatooine: Cantina, Tatooine: Docking Bay 94, Tatooine, Podrace Prep, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Anakin's Podracer, Boonta Eve Podrace and Squadron Assignments; these count toward the 60. The strategy says 'I start with Squadron Assignments' (deployed with Podrace Prep's free-Effect clause), so it is the starting Effect.
Posted 'Watch Your Step/I Told You To Watch Your Step' dested the objective Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (the back side is misnamed in the post).

Posted 'Tatooine' and 'Tatooine Cantina' dested the Light printings Tatooine (Light) (Premiere) and Tatooine: Cantina (Light); 'Tatooine Docking Bay' dested Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'I Did It' I Did It!; 'Run Luke, Run' Run Luke, Run!; 'Han w/ Heavy Blaster Pistol', 'Luke w/ Lightsaber', 'Lando w/ Blaster Pistol' and 'Chewbacca Protector' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol, Luke With Lightsaber, Lando With Blaster Pistol and Chewbacca, Protector.
The 'Epic Events' section header was mis-parsed as a card and removed; I Did It! is the one Epic Event. Total 60.
Same author's 'Ball's WYS Version 2 0' (DeckTech 17069, 27 June 2001) is a later revision of this deck with a different list.
